item.title: Santa Cruz community commemorates International Holocaust Remembrance Day
item.description: A communitywide commemoration of International Holocaust Remembrance Day was held Tuesday at the Holocaust memorial in the Home of Peace Cemetery. The event was co-sponsored by the Santa Cruz County Chapter of Hadassah, Chadeish Yameinu Jewish Renewal, Temple Beth El and Temple Beth El Sisterhood.

item.title: TikTok star Shirley Raines, known for bringing meals and respect to people on LA’s Skid Row, dies at 58
item.description: Raines began working with homeless communities in 2017.

item.title: Authorities determine no ongoing threat after gun discovery at Aptos High School
item.description: Law enforcement authorities confirmed Wednesday that a firearm, ammunition and mask discovered recently on the campus of Aptos High School are connected to an assault that occurred there three weeks prior, and that there is no ongoing threat to the school or community.

item.title: Curry helps Golden State bury Utah 140-124 behind a flurry of 3-pointers
item.description: Golden State made 23 3-pointers and never trailed over the final three quarters while racking up a season-high 140 points in Utah.

item.title: Cabrillo basketball tops Foothill in Coast Conference battle | Local Roundup
item.description: Sophomore forward Mike Carson scored 17 points, and the Cabrillo College men's basketball team beat Foothill 77-73 to conclude the first round of Coast Conference South Division action Wednesday.

item.title: US appeals court says Noem’s decision to end protections for Venezuelans in US was illegal
item.description: The decision will not have any immediate practical effect after the Supreme Court in October allowed Noem’s decision to take effect pending a final decision by the justices.

item.title: New videos show Alex Pretti scuffle with federal officers in Minneapolis 11 days before his death
item.description: The new videos have rekindled the national debate about the death of Pretti.

item.title: Scotts Valley girls storm past Santa Cruz to close in on SCCAL title repeat | High school basketball roundup
item.description: The Santa Cruz Coast Athletic League commissioner didn't hand Scotts Valley High girls basketball team the league title banner after the Falcons soundly defeated visiting Santa Cruz for the second time this season Wednesday. But everyone on both benches, as well as those who helped fill out the bleachers, knew it was essentially a title-clinching outcome.
